kimi_k3.technical_report_status: Moonshot says the technical report and further architecture/training details will follow the launch; no exact active-parameter count is stated on the launch page.

interpretation_limits: The 50B K3 value is a naive expert-fraction equivalent, not a disclosed active-parameter count.
Shared attention, embeddings, shared experts, vision components, and unequal expert sizes make 16/896 insufficient to recover exact activated parameters.
The 56x quantity is therefore a structural extreme, not an estimate to enter as ground truth.
The 2.5x scaling-efficiency statement combines architecture, training, and data-recipe changes and cannot be translated directly into a parameter multiplier.
